purpose: Capacity-prediction experiment: complete the 1/2/3/4 worker capacity curve on the same host as opencode-scale-4-diagnostic, persist next-step predictions before held-out worker-count execution, and compare an engineering-outcome-aware predictor against resource-only baselines.

deviations.reason: The provider removed deepseek-v4-flash-free from its model catalog during the task window; every request returned server-side UnknownError (verified with standalone probes, independent of concurrency). The paid successor deepseek-v4-flash was rejected for insufficient account balance. opencode/hy3-free was selected from the remaining free-tier OpenCode models after a successful standalone probe. Absolute comparability with the opencode-scale-4-diagnostic throughput levels is therefore broken; the within-experiment capacity-curve comparison is unaffected because all worker counts use the identical model.

configuration.predictionChronology: predictions.jsonl appended per step before the next worker count executes; outcomes appended separately and never rewritten

intendedCommand: node apps/cli/dist/index.js run --repo <clean-ledger-kit-copy> --tasks fixtures/ledger-kit/tasks.json --workers 1,2,3,4 --repetitions 3 --seed 20260817 --agent opencode --agent-model opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free --order worker-major --output experiments/opencode-capacity-curve
